name: Amadan's Desk
description: The strategy table gets a strategy! Amadan's Desk is a quality-of-life placable that skims excess items from your benches and deposites them into nearby storage that already holds that item, a completely new and original sorting method that has nothing to do with copper. Set a house rule that furnaces always have 500 coal, Blacksmith Benches keep 200 Star Metal for repairs, etc. It's designed to be compatible with other crafting table mods, because it keeps all the rules on itself, not on the benches it keeps tidy.
changeNote:
0.1.2: Moved variables from the modcontroller to the table, so each of your bases can have its own table. Like Teleportation Stones and Alters, tables can't be placed too close together now or their rules will conflict.

This likely means you will need to recreate your rules, sorry about that <3

Also fixed: the trash-icon delete button on the rules list was removing whichever rule happened to be at the top, not the one you clicked. Should now correctly delete the rule you actually select.
